faqs.q1: Nshobora gute gukoresha umukozi kuri MpahMapu?
faqs.a1: Shyiraho icyifuzo cy'akazi ugaragaza ikiciro, agace, n'amafaranga wishyura. Abakozi bagenzuwe bazahita basaba ako kazi, maze ubanze usuzume imyirondoro yabo n'uko bapimwe mbere yo kubakoresha.
faqs.a2: Ubwishyure bwose bukorwa mu buryo bwizewe binyuze kuri MTN Mobile Money (MoMo). Amafaranga yohererezwa abakozi iyo bamaze kurangiza akazi neza.
faqs.a3: Yego, buri mukozi wese kuri MpahMapu abanza kugenzurwa indangamuntu ye mbere y'uko ahabwa uburenganzira bwo gukora akazi, kugira ngo abakoresha bizere umutekano.
faqs.q4: Ni bande bakozi nshobora kubona kuri MpahMapu?
faqs.a4: MpahMapu ifite abakozi mu byiciro birenze 15 harimo abahereza, abasukura, abarinzi, abashoferi, abanyashanyarazi, abafundi b'amazi, abakora mu busitani, abakozi b'ibirori n'abandi.
faqs.q5: Ese MpahMapu ikorera hanze ya Kigali?
faqs.a5: MpahMapu ubu ikorera cyane cyane mu mujyi wa Kigali mu Rwanda, ariko hari gahunda yo kwagura ibikorwa no mu yindi mijyi n'intara.

hero.desc: MpahMapu ihuza abakoresha n'abakozi bagenzuwe indangamuntu kandi bapimwe mu Rwanda hose - mu birori, isuku, umutekano, gutwara ibinyabiziga n'ibindi. Baboneka mu minota mike, bishyurwa kuri MoMo.

story.title: Amateka yacu
story.p1: MpahMapu yashinzwe mu Rwanda mu 2025 nyuma yo kubona abakozi b'abahanga bahanganye no kubona akazi gahoraho, n'abakoresha bagorwa no kubona umukozi wizewe mu gihe gito cyane. Umuti wari woroshye: urubuga rufasha impande zombi mu buryo bwihuse, bugaragara, kandi bwizewe.
story.p2: Izina MpahMapu risobanura "itsinda ryishyize hamwe kugira ngo rikore" mu Kinyarwanda - kandi ni byo neza turi kubaka. Umuryango aho buri kazi gakoranwa ishema kandi buri mukozi ahabwa icyubahiro akwiriye.

how_it_works.step3_body: Tukwereka abakozi bakwiriye hashingiwe ku kiciro n'aho baherereye.
how_it_works.step4_body: Ubwishyure bwizewe bwa telefoni - nta cash, nta makimbirane.

values.title: Ibyo twemera
values.val1_body: Buri mukozi wese abanza kugenzurwa indangamuntu mbere yo kwemererwa gukora. Abakoresha bamenya neza ugiye kubakiraho.
values.val2_body: Shyiraho akazi mu gihe kitageze ku minota 2. Abakozi bahita babona ubutumwa ako kanya kandi bakemeza ku gukandaho rimwe gusa.
values.val3_body: Tugaragaza ibiciro neza mbere y'uko akazi gatangira. Nta mafaranga y'ihisho, nta makimbirane y'amafaranga - byose binyura kuri MoMo.
values.val4_body: Yubatswe i Kigali, ku banyarwanda. Twemera ko buri mukozi akwiriye agaciro kandi buri mukoresha akwiriye uwo kwizerwa.

hero.desc: Dukusanya gusa ibyo dukeneye, tukabirinda neza kandi ntitubigurisha na rimwe. Dore uko amakuru yawe akoreshwa kuri MpahMapu.

hl1.title: Ibyo dukusanya
hl1.body: Izina, numero ya telefone, indangamuntu, aho uherereye n'inshamake y'akazi - ibikenewe gusa kugira ngo urubuga rukore.

hl2.title: Uko tubirinda
hl2.body: Amakuru arafungwa haba mu gihe yoherezwa ndetse n'aho abitswe. Indangamuntu zibikwa kuri seva zihariye zifite umutekano ucunzwe neza.

hl3.title: Uwo dusangira na we
hl3.body: Dusangira gusa n'undi muntu muri mu kumvikana ku kazi, ndetse na MoMo mu gihe cyo kwishyura. Ntabwo bihishwa abamamaza na rimwe.

hl4.title: Haki ya gusiba
hl4.body: Gusaba gusiba konti yawe igihe cyose. Dusiba amakuru yawe bwite mu minsi 30, uretse aho amategeko abiguhambiriraho ukundi.

intro.summary_body: Tukoresha izina ryawe, telefone n'indangamuntu kugira ngo tukwemeze kandi dukoreshe urubuga. Kwishyura binyura kuri MoMo - ntituzana ku ntoki amafaranga yawe na rimwe. Dusangira amakuru yawe gusa n'uwo mukorana, kandi ibyo akeneye gusa. Urashobora gusiba konti yawe igihe cyose.

sec1.title: Amakuru dukusanya
sec1.body: Iyo wiyandikishije, dukusanya amazina yawe yose, numero ya telefone, n'indangamuntu y'igihugu. Abakozi kandi batanga ifoto y'indangamuntu yabo kugira ngo bemezwe. Iyo ukoresha urubuga dukusanya amakuru y'akazi, amanota uhabwa, n'amakuru rusange y'aho uherereye (urwego rw'akarere) kugira ngo tuguhuze n'akazi cyangwa abakozi bakwegereye. Ntitudukusanya amakuru ya GPS adateguye neza uretse kubyakiriye mu buryo bweruye.

sec2.title: Uko dukoresha amakuru yawe
sec2.body: Dukoresha amakuru yawe mu gushyira mu bikorwa urubuga: kwemeza abantu, guhuza abakozi n'akazi, gukoresha kwishyura rya MoMo, no kwerekana amanota yawe ku bakoresha cyangwa abakozi b'ejo hazaza. Twashobora kandi gukoresha amakuru yakusanyirijwe hamwe adafite amazina kugira ngo tunonosore algorithms zacu zo guhuza no gusobanukirwa uko urubuga rukoreshwa - aya makuru ntabwo yakwerekana wowe ubwawe.

sec3.title: Uwo dusangira na we amakuru yawe
sec3.body: Iyo akazi kemejwe, umukoresha ashobora kubona izina ry'umukozi, ifoto ye, amanota ye, n'inararibonye rye mu kiciro cy'akazi - ndetse n'umukozi akabona iby'umukoresha. Hanze y'ibyo, dusangira amakuru gusa na MTN MoMo mu gukora kwishyura ndetse, niba bisabwa n'amategeko, n'inzego z'umutekano cyangwa zishinzwe kugenzura mu Rwanda. Ntitugurisha, gukodesha cyangwa gucuruza amakuru yawe bwite n'undi muntu uwo ari we wese ku bijyanye no kwamamaza.

sec4.title: Kwemeza indangamuntu
sec4.body: Abakozi batanga indangamuntu y'igihugu mu gihe cyo kwiyandikisha. Iyi ndangamuntu isuzumwa n'itsinda ryacu rishinzwe kwemeza hanyuma ikabikwa mu buryo bufite umutekano kandi bufunguye gusa ku bemerewe. Abakozi ba MpahMapu bafite uburenganzira gusa nibo bashobora kureba indangamuntu, kandi gusa ku bw'intego yo gukemura impaka cyangwa kubahiriza amategeko. Uwemewe yerekana icyemezo (badge); indangamuntu ubwayo ntisangirwa n'abakoresha na rimwe.

sec5.title: MoMo n'amakuru yo kwishyura
sec5.body: Tubika gusa numero ya telefone ya MoMo ifitanye isano na konti yawe. Amakuru yose y'itumanaho ry'amafaranga abitse na MTN MoMo hashingiwe ku mabwiriza yabo bwite. MpahMapu ibika amakuru yo kwishyura (agaciro, itariki, inyemezabwishyu y'akazi) kugeza ku myaka 7 nk'uko bisabwa n'amategeko y'imisoro mu Rwanda.

sec6.title: Kuki (Cookies) n'isesengura ry'urubuga
sec6.body: Urubuga rwacu n'izindi mbuga dukoresha bikoresha kuki z'ingenzi kugira ngo ugume winjiye kandi twibuke ibyo ukunda. Dukoresha kandi isesengura ryerekana icyubahiro cy'umutekano w'amakuru kugira ngo tumenye ibintu bikoreshwa cyane n'aho urubuga rushobora kunonosorwa. Isesengura ry'amakuru rikusanyirizwa hamwe kandi ntirerekana umukoresha umwe ku giti cye. Urashobora gufunga kuki zitari ngombwa muri porogaramu yawe cyangwa muri mudasobwa yawe.

sec7.title: Kubika amakuru
sec7.body: Konti zikora: amakuru abikwa mu gihe cyose konti yawe igifunguye. Konti zasibwe: amakuru bwite akurwaho mu minsi 30 isabwe, uretse amakuru yo kwishyura (imyaka 7, itegeko) n'amakuru ajyanye n'impaka zitarakemuka. Amakuru adafite amazina ashobora kubikwa igihe kitazaza.

sec8.title: Uburenganzira bwawe
sec8.body: Hashingiwe ku mategeko y'u Rwanda no mu mwuka wo gukoresha neza amakuru, ufite uburenganzira bwo kubona kopi y'amakuru yawe bwite, gukosora amakuru atari yo, gusaba gusiba konti n'amakuru yawe, ndetse no kwanga bimwe mu bikorwa by'ikoranabuhanga. Kugira ngo ukoreshe ubwo burenganzira, andikira privacy@mpahmapu.com cyangwa ukoreshe ifishi y'ubufasha muri porogaramu. Tuzagusubiza mu minsi 10 y'akazi.

sec9.title: Umutekano
sec9.body: Dukoresha TLS encryption ku makuru yose mu gihe atumizwa, AES-256 encryption ku makuru yose abitse, n'uburyo bukomeye bwo kugenzura abinjira kugira ngo abakozi bakeneye amakuru mu kazi kabo gusa babe aribo bayageraho. Dukora isuzuma ry'umutekano ry'imbere mu buryo buhoraho. Niba habaye ikibazo cy'umutekano cyagira ingaruka ku makuru yawe, tuzakumenyesha mu masaha 72 hanyuma tubimenyeshe RISA (Rwanda Information Society Authority) nk'uko bisabwa.

sec10.title: Impinduka kuri aya mabwiriza
sec10.body: Twashobora kuvugurura aya mabwiriza kugira ngo bihure n'impinduka z'amategeko cyangwa z'urubuga. Niba impinduka ari ingenzi, tuzakumenyesha binyuze kuri SMS cyangwa ubutumwa muri porogaramu nibura iminsi 7 mbere y'uko bitangira gukora. Gukomeza gukoresha MpahMapu nyuma y'iyo tariki bivuze ko wemeye izo mpinduka.

sec11.title: Tuvugishe
sec11.body: Kuri bibazo by'umutekano w'amakuru, gusaba amakuru, cyangwa gutanga ikibazo, andikira privacy@mpahmapu.com. Kuri bibazo rusange andikira legal@mpahmapu.com cyangwa ukoreshe ifishi yo kutuvugisha ku rubuga rwacu.

hero.desc: Aya mategeko agenga ikoreshwa rya MpahMapu nka mfanyakazi cyangwa umukoresha. Nyamuneka yasome neza mbere yo gufungura konti.

intro.summary_body: MpahMapu ihuza abakozi n'abakoresha mu Rwanda. Ufite uburenganzira bwose ku kazi kawe n'inyungu zawe. Turengera ubutabera, kwemeza, no kwishyura binyuze kuri MoMo. Ba inyangamugayo, wubahe abandi, kandi ugere ku gihe.

sec1.title: Kwemera amategeko
sec1.body: Ukimara gufungura konti cyangwa gukoresha MpahMapu - yaba nk'umukozi cyangwa umukoresha - wemera kubahiriza aya Mategeko n'Amabwiriza. Niba utabyemeye, nyamuneka ntukoreshe urubuga. Twashobora kuvugurura aya mategeko ajo n'ajo; gukomeza gukoresha urubuga nyuma y'impinduka bivuze ko wemeye amategeko yavuguruwe.

sec2.title: Ninde wemerewe gukoresha MpahMapu
sec2.body: Ugomba kuba ufite nibura imyaka 18 kandi wemerewe n'amategeko gukora cyangwa gutanga akazi mu Rwanda kugira ngo ufungure konti. Abakozi bagomba kwemeza indangamuntu zabo mbere yo kwemera akazi. Abakoresha bagomba gutanga amakuru ya busness cyangwa amakuru bwite atagira amakosa mu gihe batanga akazi. Konti ntabwo zihabwa abandi bantu.

sec3.title: Gushyiraho no kwemera akazi
sec3.body: Abakoresha ni bo bafite inshingano zo kwemeza ko amakuru y'akazi bashyizeho ari yo - harimo aho akazi kari, igiciro, ikiciro, n'igihe kizakora. Abakozi bemera akazi hashingiwe kuri ayo makuru; gutanga amakuru atari yo bishobora gutuma konti ihagarikwa. Abakozi bagomba kurangiza akazi bemeye cyangwa bakagasesa batanga integuza ihagije. Gukomeza gusiba akazi bidafite impamvu bishobora gutuma ukurwa ku rubuga.

sec4.title: Kwishyura binyuze kuri MoMo
sec4.body: Kwishyura kose gukorwa binyuze kuri MTN Mobile Money (MoMo). Abakoresha bishyura igiciro bumvikanyeho wongeyeho ikiguzi cya MpahMapu mu gihe cyo kwemeza akazi. Amafaranga ahabwa abakozi iyo akazi karangiye. MpahMapu ntibika amafaranga igihe kirekire kirenze igikenewe kandi ntabwo ibazwa ibyerekeye gutinda kwishyura bitewe na serivisi za MoMo ubwazo.

sec5.title: Amanota n'imyitwarire
sec5.body: Haba abakozi cyangwa abakoresha bashobora guhabwa amanota (ratings) nyuma ya buri kazi karangiye. Amanota agomba kwerekana ibyabaye by'ukuri. Gutanga amanota mu buryo bw'uburiganya cyangwa ku bwo kwihorera binyuranyije n'aya mategeko kandi bishobora gukurwaho. Abakoresha bose basabwa kuvugana mu cyubahiro; guhohotera, kurobanura ku butoni, cyangwa ihohoterwa iryo ari ryo ryose bizatuma konti isibwa burundu.

sec6.title: Impaka n'uburyo bwo gusubizwa amafaranga
sec6.body: Niba habaye impaka - nk'icygereranyo, akazi katarangiye nk'uko byumvikanyweho - umwe mu mpande zombi ashobora gutanga ikirego mu masaha 48 nyuma y'uko akazi karangiye. MpahMapu izasuzuma ibimenyetso bihari hanyuma ifate umwanzuro ntakuka. Gusubizwa amafaranga, niba bikwiriye, bikorwa binyuze kuri MoMo mu minsi 3 kugeza kuri 5 y'akazi.

sec7.title: Ibibujijwe gukorwa
sec7.body: Ntabwo wemerewe gukoresha MpahMapu ushaka abakozi bo gukorera inyuma y'urubuga kugira ngo wirinde kwishyura ikiguzi, gushyiraho akazi kanyuranyije n'amategeko cyangwa gateza akaga, gukusanya amakuru bwite y'abandi bakoresha batabiguhereye uburenganzira, cyangwa kugerageza kwiba, gusuzuma cyangwa kwivanga mu mikorere y'urubuga. Kurenga kuri ibi bishobora gutuma konti yawe ihagarikwa ako kanya ndetse no kugezwa mu mategeko.

sec8.title: Imipaka y'inshingano
sec8.body: MpahMapu ni isoko ry'akazi kandi ntabwo ari umukoresha cyangwa umukozi w'uruhande urwo ari rwo rwose. Ntitwishingira ubuziranenge bw'akazi gakorwa, imyitwarire y'umukoresha uwo ari we wese, cyangwa kuboneka kw'akazi. Hashingiwe ku mategeko y'u Rwanda, inshingano za MpahMapu ku kirego icyo ari cyo cyose ntizishobora kurenza amafaranga waba warayishyuye mu minsi 30 ibanziriza ikirego.

sec9.title: Amategeko agenga urubuga
sec9.body: Aya mategeko agengwa n'amategeko ya Repubulika y'u Rwanda. Impaka zose zishobora kuvuka zitarangiriye mu buryo bw'imbere mu gukemura impaka za MpahMapu, zizashyikirizwa inkiko z'u Rwanda.

sec10.title: Tuvugishe
sec10.body: Ufite ibibazo kuri aya mategeko? Twandikire kuri legal@mpahmapu.com cyangwa ukoreshe ifishi yo kutuvugisha ku rubuga rwacu. Tugamije kugusubiza mu minsi 2 y'akazi.

owner_help.faq1_a: Kwishyura kwawe gufungirwa kuri konti ihuriweho hejuru y'uko wemeje akazi. Bihabwa umukozi gusa iyo wemeje ko akazi karangiye neza. Ufite amasaha 24 nyuma yo kurangiza akazi yo gutangiza impaka.

owner_help.faq3_a: Yego. Guhagarika ku buntu birashoboka kugeza ku masaha 2 mbere y'igihe cyagenwe. Guhagarika bitinze bishobora gukurura amande ya 10% yo kwishyura umukozi.
owner_help.faq4_a: Abakozi bose kuri MpahMapu banyura mu kugenzura ibyangombwa no gusuzuma inyandiko zabo mbere yo kwakirwa kuri platform. Badge yemeza ko bagenzuwe neza.
owner_help.faq5_q: Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kwishyura bwemewe?
owner_help.faq5_a: Ubu twemera MTN MoMo na Airtel Money. Kohereza kuri banki biraza vuba cyane.

seeker_help.faq1_a: Amafaranga yawe afungirwa muri escrow iyo akazi gatangiye maze agahita yoherezwa kuri wallet yawe iyo umukoresha yemeje ko akazi karangiye. Ushobora kuyakura kuri wallet ukayohereza kuri MTN MoMo cyangwa Airtel Money umunsi wose.
seeker_help.faq2_a: Dukata 25% ku mafaranga umukozi yorejwe kugira ngo tubashe kubungabunga platform, kugenzura abakoresha n'abakozi, ndetse no kwishyura MoMo transactions.
seeker_help.faq3_a: Emeza ko umwirondoro wawe, ubumenyi, amashuri, ndetse n'akarere utuyemo byuzuye neza. Abakoresha bashobora kugushakira ahabonetse abakozi cyangwa nawe ugasaba akazi katangajwe mu isoko ry'imirimo.
seeker_help.faq4_a: Iyo urangije akazi, baza umukoresha wawe gusikana badge yawe y'umukozi cyangwa kwemeza ko akazi karangiye kuri dashboard ye kugira ngo amafaranga yawe arekurwe.
seeker_help.faq5_a: Iyo umukoresha wanze kurekura amafaranga cyangwa agafungura impaka, ikipe yacu isuzuma impaka zose mu masaha 2. Duvugana n'impande zombi tugakemura ikibazo hashingiwe ku bimenyetso by'akazi kakozwe.

escrow.overview: Hano kuri MpahMapu, dukoresha uburyo bwo gufunga amafaranga (escrow) bwizewe kandi bwikora. Kuri buri kazi kamaze kwemezwa, amafaranga ahita afungirwa akurwa kuri wallet y'umukoresha. Ibi byizera umukozi ko igihe cye n'imbaraga ze bitazapfa ubusa ndetse ko ubwishyu bwemejwe na mbere y'uko agera aho akazi gakorerwa. Igiciro kibarwa nk'igiciro cy'isaha × amasaha × umubare w'abakozi wongeyeho 5% ya service fee yo gufunga ubwishyu.
escrow.process: Iyo ukanze 'Book Now', sisitemu ihita yakira ubusabe bwawe saa {time} ikazibira amafaranga yose hamwe. Amafaranga aguma afunzwe muri escrow mu gihe cyose cy'akazi. Iyo umukozi arangije akazi, yerekana badge ye y'umukozi ifite QR code. Gusikana iyi badge cyangwa gukanda 'Mark Complete' bihita birekura amafaranga ako kanya akajya kuri wallet y'umukozi.
escrow.guidelines: Amafaranga yose yafunzwe agengwa n'amabwiriza yacu yo kugenzura. Abakoresha bafite amasaha agera kuri 24 nyuma yo kurangiza akazi kugira ngo bagenzure ubuziranenge bwako. Iyo impaka zafunguwe, amafaranga aguma afunzwe kugeza igihe ikipe yacu ishinzwe ubufasha isuzumye ibimenyetso ikagira umwanzuro ifata.

seeker.overview: Nk'umukozi, amafaranga yawe afungirwa neza muri escrow igihe umukoresha akwemereye akazi — bityo umushahara wawe uba wemejwe na mbere y'uko ujya ku kazi. Ntutegereza gukurikirana umukoresha ngo aguhe amafaranga.
seeker.process: Amafaranga aguma afunzwe mu gihe cyose cy'akazi. Iyo urangije, umukoresha asikana badge yawe ya QR cyangwa agakanda 'Mark Complete', maze ubwishyu bukoherezwa ako kanya kuri wallet yawe ya MpahMapu, witeguye kuyakura.

public.overview: Escrow irinda impande zombi. Iyo umukoresha yemereye umukozi akazi, amafaranga yose afungirwa ku konti yizewe: umukozi amenya ko amafaranga yemejwe naho umukoresha akamenya ko arekurwa gusa iyo akazi karangiye.
public.process: Amafaranga aguma afunzwe mu gihe cy'akazi. Iyo akazi kemejwe ko karangiye — usikanye badge ya QR y'umukozi cyangwa ukanze 'Mark Complete' — ubwishyu buhita bwoherezwa kuri wallet y'umukozi.

payout.overview: Ushobora gukura amafaranga ari kuri wallet yawe ya MpahMapu ukayohereza kuri Mobile Money igihe cyose ushakiye.
payout.process: Fungura Wallet yawe, ukande 'Withdraw', wandike umubare w'amafaranga na numero yawe ya MTN MoMo cyangwa Airtel Money, hanyuma wemeze. Amafaranga akoherezwa kuri konti yawe ya mobile money, akenshi mu minota mike.
payout.guidelines: Genzura neza umubare w'amafaranga na numero ya telefone mbere yo kwemeza. Niba amafaranga adageze, reba aho ageze kuri transactions za wallet yawe cyangwa uvugane na support tuyakurikirane.

seeker.overview: Umushahara wawe ugera kuri wallet yawe ya MpahMapu nyuma ya buri kazi urangije — usigarana 75% nyuma yo gukatwa 25% ya platform fee. Uhereye aho ushobora gukura amafaranga ukayohereza kuri Mobile Money igihe cyose.

owner.overview: Amafaranga asigaye kuri wallet yawe y'umukoresha — nk'ayakuwe mu kazi kahagaritswe cyangwa top-up utakoresheje — ushobora kuyakura ukayasubiza kuri konti yawe ya Mobile Money.

refund.overview: Twemera ko amaprogram ashobora guhinduka, bityo rero MpahMapu ibaha uburyo bwo gusubizwa amafaranga mu mucyo. Iyo akazi gahagaritswe mu buryo bwemewe, amafaranga yose yari yafunzwe ahita asubizwa kuri wallet y'umukoresha. Gusubizwa bikorwa mu gihe nyacyo (real-time) kugira ngo konti yawe igume ifite amafaranga.
refund.process: Niba ushaka gusubizwa amafaranga, jya ahanditse Payments, uhitemo transaction yafunzwe (HELD), maze ukande 'Request Refund'. Kuri gahunda z'akazi zigifunguye, guhagarika bikozwe mbere y'amasaha 2 ngo akazi gatangire bisubizwa 100%. Iyo uhagaritse mu masaha ari munsi ya 2 akazi gasigaje, ukatwa 10% yo guha indishyi umukozi.
refund.guidelines: Ubusabe bwose bwo gusubizwa amafaranga nyuma y'uko akazi gatangira busuzumwa n'ikipe yacu. Ikipe yacu isuzuma ibiganiro bya chat, raporo z'akazi, ndetse n'umwirondoro w'abakoresha. Iyo byemejwe, amafaranga ahita agaragara kuri wallet yawe kandi ushobora kuyakura ukayohereza kuri MTN MoMo cyangwa Airtel Money.

seeker.overview: Nk'umukozi ntusaba gusubizwa amafaranga — umushahara wawe urinzwe na escrow. Ndetse, iyo umukoresha ahagaritse akazi bitinze (mu masaha ari munsi ya 2 ngo gatangire), uhabwa indishyi ya 10% kubera integuza ngufi.
seeker.process: Iyo akazi kahagaritswe bitinze cyangwa impaka zikemuwe ku ruhande rwawe, indishyi iyo ari yo yose ishyirwa kuri wallet yawe ya MpahMapu, kandi ushobora kuyakura ukoresheje MTN MoMo cyangwa Airtel Money.

public.overview: Gusubizwa amafaranga birinda impande zombi. Iyo akazi kahagaritswe mu buryo bwemewe, escrow y'umukoresha isubizwa kuri wallet ye; iyo gahagaritswe umwanya wa nyuma, umukozi ahabwa indishyi kubera integuza ngufi.

verify.overview: Umutekano n'ubwizerane nibyo dushyira imbere cyane. Buri mukozi ndetse n'umukoresha kuri MpahMapu anyura mu kugenzura umwirondoro (identity verification) mbere yo gukoresha platform. Ibi bituma twubaka umuryango w'abanyamwuga bizewe kandi bagenzuwe i Kigali.
verify.process: Mu gihe cyo kwiyandikisha, abakozi bohereza ikarita y'indangamuntu (ID), inyandiko z'ubushinjacyaha (police clearance), ndetse n'abantu bashobora kubemeza (references). Ikipe yacu isuzuma buri busabe mu masaha 24. Abakozi bagenzuwe bahabwa badge y'icyatsi kibara umutekano kuri profile yabo.
verify.guidelines: Dukurikiranira hafi amanota (ratings) abakozi bahabwa. Iyo umukozi abonye amanota ari munsi ya 3.5 stars, profile ye ihita ishyirwa mu gihe cy'igerageza. Ibyangombwa bidasanzwe bigenzurwa kabiri mu mwaka. Ubwifatanye cyangwa imyitwarire mibi ihita itemesha badge y'umukozi.

owner.overview: Buri mukozi kuri MpahMapu agenzurwa umwirondoro mbere y'uko ashobora guhabwa akazi, bityo ushobora kwizera uwo utumira. Shakisha badge yemejwe kuri profile y'umukozi.
owner.process: Kugira ngo wemeze umukozi runaka, sikana QR code iri kuri badge ye cyangwa wandike badge ID ye ku rupapuro rwo kugenzura. Uhita ubona niba ari umukozi nyawe kandi ukora.

public.overview: Umutekano ni cyo dushyira imbere: buri mukozi anyura mu kugenzura umwirondoro n'ubushinjacyaha mbere yo kwinjira, kandi buri wese afite badge yemejwe ishobora gusikanwa kugira ngo abakoresha bamenye neza uwo bahaye akazi.

fee.overview: Kugira ngo tubashe gukomeza kubungabunga platform, kohereza ubwishyu mu buryo bwihuse, ndetse n'umutekano w'abakoresha n'abakozi, MpahMapu yaka amafaranga ya service fee. Iyi fee idufasha kugenzura profiles, kwishyura MTN MoMo transactions, ndetse no gukemura impaka.
fee.process: Abakozi bakatwa {fee} kuri buri mushahara bahawe. Nk'urugero, niba akazi kishyuwe RWF 10,000, RWF 2,500 ihita ikatwa ku buryo bwikora, maze RWF 7,500 ikoherezwa kuri wallet yawe. Abakoresha bo bishyura gusa 5% ya transaction fee mu gihe cyo gufunga escrow.
fee.guidelines: Amafaranga yose yashyizweho na platform agaragara mu mucyo kuri fagitire yawe munsi ya tab ya My Earnings. Iyi service fee ntishobora gusubizwa kuko ikoreshwa mu kwishyura payment processors ndetse no gupayisha server. Inyandiko zose zoherezwa kuri email yawe.

owner.process: Nk'umukoresha wishyura gusa 5% ya service fee yiyongera ku mafaranga yumvikanyweho y'abakozi, igaragazwa mu mucyo mbere yo kwemeza. Nk'urugero, ku kazi ka RWF 10,000 wishyura RWF 10,500 muri rusange. Nta yandi mafaranga yo guha akazi.

seeker.process: Nk'umukozi, {fee} ya service fee ikatwa ku mushahara wawe, bityo uhabwa 75%. Nk'urugero, niba akazi kishyuwe RWF 10,000, RWF 2,500 ikatwa naho RWF 7,500 ikagera kuri wallet yawe.

job.overview: MpahMapu ihuza abakozi b'abanyamyuga benshi cyane n'ibigo by'ubucuruzi ndetse n'ingo zitandukanye i Kigali. Kubona akazi biroroshye cyane iyo profile yawe yuzuye neza. Gira ubumenyi, ibiciro by'isaha, ndetse n'amasaha ukoramo byuzuye kugira ngo uhure n'ubusabe bw'abakoresha.
job.process: Iyo abakoresha bakeneye abakozi, bashobora gutangaza akazi mu isoko ry'imirimo cyangwa bagashakira ahanditse abakozi bagenzuwe. Ushobora gushakisha mu isoko, ukareba igiciro cy'isaha, maze ugasaba. Iyo umukoresha nemeye ubusabe bwawe, akazi gahita gatangira ku munsi wagenwe.
job.guidelines: Abakozi bakwiriye gusaba gusa imirimo bafitiye ubumenyi buhagije. Gutinda cyangwa kutaboneka ku kazi utatanze integuza y'amasaha 24 mbere bigabanya amanota yawe kandi bishobora gutuma konti yawe ihagarikwa by'agateganyo. Koresha chat kugira ngo uvugane n'umukoresha.

owner.overview: Ukeneye guha akazi? Gutangaza akazi kuri MpahMapu bisaba gukanda gake gusa. Hitamo icyiciro, ushyireho itariki, aho gakorerwa, umubare w'abakozi n'igiciro, maze abakozi bagenzuwe bari hafi bahita bamenyeshwa.
owner.process: Kanda 'Post a Job', wuzuze amakuru, hanyuma wishyure escrow ukoresheje wallet yawe, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money cyangwa ikarita. Abakozi bagenzuwe bari hafi bashobora gusaba, cyangwa ushobora gutumira umwe wenyine ukoresheje 'Hire Now' maze ukareba abasabye mbere yo kwemeza.

public.overview: MpahMapu ihuza abantu bakeneye ko akazi gakorwa n'abakozi baho bagenzuwe mu Rwanda hose. Iyandikishe nk'Umukozi kugira ngo uhabwe akazi, cyangwa nk'Umukoresha kugira ngo utangaze akazi kandi uhe akazi — ushobora no gutangaza akazi ka mbere nk'umushyitsi.

complete.overview: Kwemeza ko akazi karangiye niyo ntambwe ya nyuma muri MpahMapu. Ibi byerekana sisitemu ko imirimo yari yashyiranyweho yarangiye neza, bityo ko igomba kurekura amafaranga yari yafunzwe ikayahereza umukozi.
complete.process: Iyo urangije amasaha yawe y'akazi, yereke umukoresha QR code badge yawe. Arabisikana akoresheje camera y'intelefone ye, cyangwa agakanda 'Mark Complete' kuri dashboard ye. Ubwishyu buhita bwoherezwa kuri wallet yawe ako kanya.
complete.guidelines: Emeza ko umukoresha yemeza akazi mbere y'uko uvaho. Iyo yabyibagiwe, mwandikire mu mucyo kuri chat. Iyo umukoresha wanze kwemeza ko akazi karangiye kandi wamukoreye, contacta support ya BazaBot maze uheze ibimenyetso by'akazi.

owner.overview: Kwemeza ko akazi karangiye ni bwo buryo urekura ubwishyu bwari bwafunzwe ukabuha umukozi. Ni intambwe ya nyuma, ikorwa iyo unyuzwe n'uko akazi kumvikanyweho karangiye.
owner.process: Nyuma y'uko umukozi yemeje ko akazi karangiye akoresheje badge ye ya QR, fungura akazi kuri dashboard yawe maze ukande 'Mark Complete' — cyangwa usikane badge ye. Ubwishyu buhita bwoherezwa umukozi, hanyuma ushobora kumuha amanota.

dispute.overview: Nubwo dukora ibishoboka byose kugira ngo imirimo igende neza, impaka zishobora kuvuka hagati y'umukoresha n'umukozi. MpahMapu ifite ishami rishinzwe gukemura impaka zishingiye ku buziranenge bw'akazi, amasaha yakozwe, cyangwa ubwishyu.
dispute.process: Niba ushaka gufungura impaka, jya ku rupapuro rw'akazi maze ukande 'Raise Dispute'. Usabwa kohereza ibimenyetso nka photos z'akazi kakozwe, chat screenshots, cyangwa inyandiko z'amasaha. Ikipe yacu ihita imenyekanishwa maze ikafunga ubwishyu.
dispute.guidelines: Kugenzura impaka bitangira mu masaha 2 y'akazi. Abalive agents bacu bavugana n'umukoresha ndetse n'umukozi kugira ngo bumve impande zombi. Umwanzuro ufatwa nta kubogama hashingiwe ku miterere y'akazi n'ibimenyetso, maze amafaranga akarekurwa.

fallback.overview: Ikibazo cyawe gisaba ubufasha bw'umuntu (live agent). BazaBot yabitse inyandiko zose z'ibiganiro twagiranye ndetse n'amakuru ya konti yawe kugira ngo ifungure ubusabe bw'ubufasha (support ticket) buhambaye mu buryo bwa sisitemu yacu.
fallback.process: Sisitemu yacu yafunguye ticket nshya saa {time} maze ihita yoherereza email ya alarm abadmin bose kuri platform. Manager ushinzwe ubufasha agiye gusuzuma ibiganiro maze ahite akwandikira kuri email yawe wiyandikishijeho.
fallback.guidelines: Kugira ngo ubone ubufasha vuba cyane, ushobora gukanda ku gice cy'icyatsi kibara 'WhatsApp Call' cyangwa 'Live Chat' hejuru ku rupapuro. Ibi bikugeza kuri support team yacu kuri WhatsApp maze ukavugana n'umuntu ako kanya.
